mapper.select: SELECT ESB_SEQ AS ESB_SEQ -- PK , STU_FLNM AS STDNT_FLNM_ENCPT -- 학생성명암호화 , STU_BRDT AS STDNT_BRTH_YMD -- 학생생년월일 , SXDS_SC_CD AS STDNT_SXDC_NM -- 학생성별 , STU_ADDR_POST_NO AS ADDR_ZIP -- 우편번호 , STU_ADDR AS STDNT_ADDR -- 학생주소 , STU_DTL_ADDR AS STDNT_DTL_ADDR -- 학생상세주소 , STU_TELNO AS STDNT_TELNO -- 학생전화번호 , STU_MBL_TELNO AS STDNT_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT , STU_EML_ADDR AS STDNT_EML_ADDR_ENCPT , STTY_AGT_TELNO , STTY_AGT_EML_ADDR AS STTY_AGT_EML_ADDR_ENCPT , SHL_NM AS LAST_SCHL_GRADE_NM -- 최종학교명 , SHL_CD AS SHL_CD , substr(SHL_CD, 0,3) AS MOE_OFCDC_SE_CD -- , SCWK_HALT_YMD AS SCHULW_DSCNTC_YMD -- 학업중단일자 , SCWK_HALT_RSN_CD AS SCHULW_DSCNTC_CS_CN -- 학업중단사유내용 , HOP_COSE_ETC_CN AS HNCFRT_HPE_COSE_NM -- 향후진로명 , STU_AGRE_STS_CD AS STDNT_WRTCNS_SBMSN_YN -- 학생동의여부 , STTY_AGT_AGRE_STS_CD AS STTY_AGT_WRTCNS_SBMSN_YN -- 법정대리인동의여부 FROM CAD100 WHERE ESB_STATUS = 'S'
SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MOE_SCHULW_DSCNTC_SCLAS_SE_CD' AND UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN ('04','06')

SELECT /* isry.batchJobs.drmgs.eduLink.mapper.EduLinkMapper.selectDupChk(중복등록확인) */ COUNT(1) AS sDupChk FROM AKA221 /* 교육청집단연계-업로드파일상세 */ WHERE 1=1 AND STDNT_FLNM_ENCPT = #{STDNT_FLNM_ENCPT} AND STDNT_BRTH_YMD = #{STDNT_BRTH_YMD} AND STDNT_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT = #{STDNT_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT}

SELECT /* isry.batchJobs.drmgs.eduLink.mapper.EduLinkMapper.selectStdntAge(학생나이구하기) */ TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), TO_DATE(#{STDNT_BRTH_YMD},'YYYYMMDD')) / 12) AS AGE FROM DUAL /* 교육청집단연계-업로드파일상세 */

SELECT CMMNS_CD_ID , CMMNS_CD_VALUE , UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE , CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 , ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE2 , ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE3 , ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE4 , ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE5 FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = #{CMMNS_CD_ID}
